All alternatives are authored from these declared functions; deliberate mistakes are not source-image facts.
A: 2*x; domain all real x. Full straight line;mistake sqrt(x^2)=x even for negatives.
B: abs(x)+x; domain all real x. Correct:left horizontal rayy0,right rayy2x,included origin. Graph color must remain visible on top of the x-axis.
C: abs(x)-x; domain all real x. Left rayy=-2x,righty0;mistake subtracting rather than addingx.
D: abs(x); domain all real x. V shape;mistake dropping the addedx term.

authoritativeText.text:
1104. 作出由下列方程给出的函数的图象：
a) $y=\sqrt{x^2}+x$；
b) $y=\sqrt{x^2}-x$；
c) $y=|x+2|$；
d) $y=|x-1|$。
